title: U字型車止め
description: 歩道の入口や駐輪場に置く、溶融亜鉛めっき鋼管のU字型車止めです。曲げ加工したパイプ、黄色の反射帯、根元のカラーと表面設置用ベースプレート、アンカーナットを造形しています。チェーン、鍵付き脱着機構、埋設基礎は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.200 × 0.832 × 0.200 m、3,576三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A galvanized steel-pipe U-shaped barrier for sidewalk entrances and bicycle parking. It models the bent pipe, yellow reflective bands, base collars, surface-mount base plates and anchor nuts. Chains, lockable removable sockets and buried foundations are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.200 × 0.832 × 0.200 m; 3,576 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
